note: Mulligan to 6 with Island, Misty, Ancient Tomb, Brainstorm x2, Aluren, Atraxa: bottomed Aluren (needs GG plus Acererak, neither in hand) over the second Brainstorm. Keeping Aluren keeps a second combo route; keeping Brainstorm digs harder for Show and Tell for the Atraxa in hand.

T4 Atraxa reveal after taking Tropical, Veil, Show and Tell, Petal: chose Done with Acererak still offered. Taking it costs one extra cleanup discard (Misty or a Stock Up) and gives the Aluren route its creature; the playbook says take fewer only to skip cards you would discard anyway.

T6 Stock Up second pick after Omniscience: took a second Lotus Petal over Aluren (and Ponder). Aluren would give a second win route next turn (Tomb + Tropical + Petal = 2GG, Acererak in hand) besides Show and Tell for Omniscience; Petal only saved Ancient Tomb life.

T8 under Omniscience, loop about to start, opp holding 1 card (Swords) with W open: Atraxa reveal Done after Force of Will + Aluren, leaving Acererak, Stock Up and a land. Hand size is irrelevant on the combo turn; a spare Acererak would have covered the legend-rule loss (prompt 77) and Swords on the last copy without needing the Force.

T5 Swords on the Show-and-Tell Atraxa (opp gains 7, to 25) before attacking, vs holding Swords for Acererak/the known second Show and Tell. B's report doubts it; a 7/7 lifelink flier blocks and races, so removing it looks right, but Brady's view on Swords allocation vs Alurentell helps.

T5 played Wasteland and used it at once on Ancient Tomb (opp's only nonbasic; Tropical known in hand) instead of holding Wasteland for Tropical (their green source for Aluren) or using it as a third mana source for Sand Scout. It cost A a turn (no Stock Up + Show and Tell on T6).
